scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: tsc -b packages/shared packages/agqp packages/vault-crypto packages/pyth-verify packages/tx-policy
scripts.dev:packages: tsc -b --watch packages/shared packages/agqp packages/vault-crypto packages/pyth-verify packages/tx-policy
scripts.test:live: npm run build:packages && vitest run --config vitest.live.config.ts
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:live && npm run test:system
scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/*/dist packages/*/*.tsbuildinfo apps/web/.next apps/vault/dist apps/relayer/dist
